Problem Statement:
Create a program to find the k-th smallest element in an array. The twist is that you must implement the Quickselect algorithm and handle arrays with duplicate values efficiently. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains n integers, the elements of the array. The third line contains an integer k, the position (1-based) of the smallest element to find. 
Output Description:
A single integer, the k-th smallest element in the array. 
Sample Input:
67 10 4 3 20 153 
Sample Output:
7
